name: hbm_host_static_ingress_p6-p6-COMMIT
purpose: Host static ingress re-pinned to <= 6 pins/um per face (coordinator HBM die audit 10-16 / H-DIE d4c rule): every face window widened x2.05 about its centre, pin_min_tracks 4 (0.192 um pitch, 5.1/um; was 0.096 = 10.4/um). Same 216 square, RTL, faces, port order, benches.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_host_static_ingress #(.MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/host_static_20261015/ot_hbm_host_static_ingress.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbm_host_static_ingress_p6/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbm_host_static_ingress_p6/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: | p6 (H-SU/PIN 1840, 10-16): pin density 10.4 -> 5.1 pins/um (windows x2.05, pin_min_tracks 4), same outline/RTL.

reroute_reason.slot_change_request: coordinator HBM die audit 10-16 (H-ELEM a8f894a1644e6a104): pins <= 6/um per face; H-DIE d4c band rule (a847da73f3ce48781). Same 216 square; pin windows x2.05 about each face centre at 0.192 um pitch; new windows sent to H-DIE.
